tuning_key.text: Our lives respond to vibrations, that we can enjoy / If we spend our time on actions that fulfill us, that fill us with joy
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The actions that fill you with joy aren't luxuries—they're the frequency your nervous system was built to broadcast. Today, the field is asking you to notice what already feels like play, what already moves without resistance, and to let that become your primary signal. This isn't about earning joy through discipline; it's about recognizing that joy, when it appears, is already the tuning.

practice.title: Locate the Effortless
practice.instruction: Pause and scan your last 24 hours for one action—however small—that you did without pushing, that felt like it moved you rather than you moving it; notice where in your body that memory lives.

practice.title: Match the Vibration
practice.instruction: For the next 3 minutes, let your breath find the rhythm of that action—not controlling it, but letting your inhale and exhale echo the pace at which joy naturally moves through you.

practice.title: Broadcast the Return
practice.instruction: Name one small thing you'll do today that carries that same frequency, then listen to the echo audio to feel the field recognizing the signal you're about to send.
